basic_details.job_title: CSIR-SERC Security Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: CSIR-Structural Engineering Research Centre (CSIR-SERC), Chennai, Tamil Nadu, has invited applications for the post of Security Assistant under Advt No. SE-1/2026. The online application is open from 20 November 2026 to 21 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online through SB Collect, CSIR-SERC (link in the online application form).

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 28 years (as on closing date of online application)

qualification.education_qualification: Ex-servicemen, JCO in Army or equivalent in other Paramilitary Forces with five years experience in the work of security.
qualification.details: Qualification: Ex-servicemen, JCO in Army or equivalent in other Paramilitary Forces with five years experience in the work of security. Experience: Five years experience in the work of security Age limit: Maximum 28 years (as on closing date of online application) Age relaxation: Ex-servicemen As defined under Rule 2(c) of Ex-Servicemen (Re-employment in Central Civil Services and Posts) Rules, 1979, Widows, divorced women and women judicially separated, not remarried Up to 35 years, SC/ST/OBC applying against UR post Not eligible for age relaxation, General Relaxable as per CSIR rules | Other conditions: | Applicant must be a citizen of India Must meet the physical standards and physical test in Annexure-I Must stay in Essential Staff Accommodation Quarters in the CSIR-TTRS campus Post carries All India Service Liability | Desirable: | Good verbal communication in Hindi & English and written communication skill Knowledge of computer, modern fire-fighting, watch and ward security monitoring systems Knowledge of local language will be an added advantage

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay Matrix Level 6 (Rs. 35,400 - 1,12,400); gross emoluments about Rs. 63,570 per month

pattern_table.Subject: General Intelligence, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, Problem Solving, Situational Judgment etc.

exam_pattern.details: Personality Assessment Test is OMR-based or computer-based objective MCQ, set in English and Hindi Competitive Written Examination is subjective; it can be taken in English or Hindi

how_to_apply: Apply online through the CSIR-SERC website https://www.serc.res.in; no other mode is accepted.
The online link is available from 20.11.2026 (10:00 Hrs.) to 21.12.2026 (17:00 Hrs.).
UR/OBC/EWS candidates pay Rs. 500 through the SB Collect link in the online form and enter the transaction details.
Upload required documents in PDF format, with photo and signature in the respective fields.
Download a copy of the application and payment details; do not send a hard copy to CSIR-SERC.
important_instructions: Do not send the hard copy of the online application to CSIR-SERC No TA for attending the tests and examination Details of shortlisted candidates and test dates will be notified on https://www.serc.res.in Helpdesk for technical issues: [email protected] / 044-22549231 (10:00 AM to 5:30 PM on working days)

content_sections.heading: CSIR-SERC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. SE-1/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CSIR-SERC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Ex-servicemen, JCO in Army or equivalent in other Paramilitary Forces with five years experience in the work of security. Experience: Five years experience in the work of security Age limit: Maximum 28 years (as on closing date of online application) Age relaxation: Ex-servicemen As defined under Rule 2(c) of Ex-Servicemen (Re-employment in Central Civil Services and Posts) Rules, 1979, Widows, divorced women and women judicially separated, not remarried Up to 35 years, SC/ST/OBC applying against UR post Not eligible for age relaxation, General Relaxable as per CSIR rules Other conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India Must meet the physical standards and physical test in Annexure-I Must stay in Essential Staff Accommodation Quarters in the CSIR-TTRS campus Post carries All India Service Liability Desirable: Good verbal communication in Hindi & English and written communication skill Knowledge of computer, modern fire-fighting, watch and ward security monitoring systems Knowledge of local language will be an added advantage

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for CSIR-SERC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Divyangjan/Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) are not eligible for the post

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Probation as per extant CSIR rules from the date of taking over charge; may be extended or curtailed Isolated post; promotion governed by CSIR extant rules/regulations

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online through SB Collect, CSIR-SERC (link in the online application form).

content_sections.heading: How Will CSIR-SERC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening of applications by Screening Committee Skill/Physical Test and Personality Assessment Test (qualifying) Competitive Written Examination (merit list) Physical standards: male height 167 cm (General), female 157 cm; male chest 80/85 cm Physical test: male 1600 m in 6 min 30 sec; female 800 m in 4 min; long jump, chin ups, push ups, sit ups Personality Assessment Test: 100 objective questions, 100 marks, 1 hour 30 minutes, qualifying, minimum 30% Competitive Written Examination: subjective, 100 marks, 2 hours, Class XII standard Final merit list based only on the Competitive Written Examination; minimum threshold not less than 35% Tie resolved as per CSIR Letter No. 5-1(211)/2014-PD Dt. 30.05.2023

content_sections.heading: CSIR-SERC Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Personality Assessment Test is OMR-based or computer-based objective MCQ, set in English and Hindi Competitive Written Examination is subjective; it can be taken in English or Hindi

rows.subject: General Intelligence, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, Problem Solving, Situational Judgment etc.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: 10th/SSC Certificate as DoB proof (mandatory) Ex-Servicemen Certificate and Full Discharge Book (mandatory for those claiming Ex-Servicemen) Experience/Service Certificate(s) with post held, period of service and Pay Level (mandatory) Valid proof of identity such as Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID or Driving License (mandatory) NOC with vigilance clearance from present employer as per Annexure-III, wherever applicable SB Collect receipt of Rs. 500, educational certificates and mark sheets, caste certificate if applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-SERC Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online through the CSIR-SERC website https://www.serc.res.in; no other mode is accepted. The online link is available from 20.11.2026 (10:00 Hrs.) to 21.12.2026 (17:00 Hrs.). UR/OBC/EWS candidates pay Rs. 500 through the SB Collect link in the online form and enter the transaction details. Upload required documents in PDF format, with photo and signature in the respective fields. Download a copy of the application and payment details; do not send a hard copy to CSIR-SERC.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Do not send the hard copy of the online application to CSIR-SERC No TA for attending the tests and examination Details of shortlisted candidates and test dates will be notified on https://www.serc.res.in Helpdesk for technical issues: [email protected] / 044-22549231 (10:00 AM to 5:30 PM on working days)

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSIR-SERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 21 December 2026. Applications opened on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-SERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Security Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CSIR-SERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: UR/OBC/EWS and all other candidates including in-service candidates: Rs. 500 (non-refundable). SC/ST/Ex-servicemen/Women candidates and regular employees of CSIR: No fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 28 years (as on closing date of online application). Relaxation: Ex-servicemen As defined under Rule 2(c) of Ex-Servicemen (Re-employment in Central Civil Services and Posts) Rules, 1979, Widows, divorced women and women judicially separated, not remarried Up to 35 years, SC/ST/OBC applying against UR post Not eligible for age relaxation, General Relaxable as per CSIR rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Matrix Level 6 (Rs. 35,400 - 1,12,400); gross emoluments about Rs. 63,570 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ex-servicemen, JCO in Army or equivalent in other Paramilitary Forces with five years experience in the work of security.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must be a citizen of India. Must meet the physical standards and physical test in Annexure-I. Must stay in Essential Staff Accommodation Quarters in the CSIR-TTRS campus. Post carries All India Service Liability.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Divyangjan/Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) are not eligible for the post.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening of applications by Screening Committee. Skill/Physical Test and Personality Assessment Test (qualifying). Competitive Written Examination (merit list). Physical standards: male height 167 cm (General), female 157 cm; male chest 80/85 cm.
